types.name: Derives
types.description: The target is derived from the source (e.g. a system requirement from a user requirement).

types.name: Satisfies
types.description: The source satisfies the target (e.g. a software requirement satisfies a system requirement).

types.name: Verifies
types.description: The source (a test case) verifies the target (a requirement).

types.name: Refers
types.description: Informative reference between any two objects; not counted in coverage.

Derives.description: UR derives SR and SR derives SW. Skipping a level (UR to SW) is allowed but reported as a gap. Derives links must not form a cycle.

descriptions.tr: UR, SR'yi; SR, SW'yi türetir. Bir seviyeyi atlamak (UR'den SW'ye) izinlidir ama boşluk olarak raporlanır. Türetme bağlantıları döngü oluşturamaz.

Satisfies.description: SW satisfies SR, SR satisfies UR, and a design item (DI) satisfies any requirement.

descriptions.tr: SW, SR'yi; SR, UR'yi karşılar. Tasarım öğesi (DI) herhangi bir gereksinimi karşılayabilir.

Verifies.description: Only a test case (TC) can verify a requirement.

descriptions.tr: Bir gereksinimi yalnızca test senaryosu (TC) doğrulayabilir.

Refers.description: Informative: any object may refer to any object.

descriptions.tr: Bilgilendirici: her nesne her nesneye atıf yapabilir.
